description: Secrets api.proto documents whose names the converter does not catch: CreateToken mints a session token (CreateTokenResponse.token), and SetVar with kind="secret" stores a secret value that ListVars never returns (SetVarRequest.value; VarItem.value is "always empty for secrets"). Mark them sensitive so the token comes back Redacted and the value is redacted in logs. CreateApiKeyResponse.api_key and ResetRdpPasswordResponse.password are already marked by name.
